claim_checks.claim: CSS is represented as N×N×L adjacency tensor; nonnegative Poisson Tucker rate with outgoing U, incoming V, layer/cognitive Y memberships, and K×K×C core G; these are weights not normalized probabilities.
claim_checks.result: Supported; note dimensions and interpretation are accurate.

claim_checks.claim: Independent (C=L,Y=I), dependent (C<L), redundant (C=1,Y=ones), and SCA (C<L,U=Y) variants; SCA equates structures/generative models, not identical perceptions.

KL multiplicative updates and Algorithm 2 constrained fit order, averaging U/Y, best-iterate termination; standard Algorithm 1 local optimum while SCA heuristic is nonmonotonic without convergence guarantee; 20 standard and 50 SCA restarts.
claim_checks.result: Supported; note does not assert global optimization.

claim_checks.claim: Nonidentifiability/global-max concerns invalidate ordinary Wilks LRT assumptions; split-LRT avoids identifiability/nesting assumptions but is lower powered, random split may be suboptimal, and still needs maximized null likelihood.
Five tubular masks, best training-likelihood among 20 starts, average test AUC; comparisons and dimensions; final fitting/interpretation pipeline.

Four CSS datasets and SCA test outcomes: agreement for Krackhardt friendship and Hunter week six; distinct social/cognitive spaces better for Krackhardt advice and Hunter week one; week-one gender alignment becomes less evident by week six.
claim_checks.result: Supported; note gives scoped observations and does not treat inferred cognitive labels as directly measured semantics.

claim_checks.claim: Limitations: coarse SBM may miss schemas such as triadic closure; limited context metadata constrains interpretation; no complete tensor-splitting implementation is specified.

references.check: Independently normalized each source title (case/diacritics/punctuation-insensitive) and searched the complete publisher bibliography sequentially in note order; all 71/71 titles matched and order was preserved. Also checked count and targets: no opaque IDs or forbidden filename characters.

title_order_comparison.method: Normalized each note alias and searched sequentially through full source bibliography text, preserving order; title labels compared case/diacritics/punctuation-insensitively.

conflicts_or_gaps: The split-LRT has lower power and an arbitrary tensor split may be suboptimal; these limitations are explicit in source and note.
The NNTuck does not semantically identify the schema; fitted spaces receive contextual interpretation and dataset metadata is limited.
No full tensor splitting implementation is specified in the paper; note discloses the missing implementation details.
